subject: Acme Corp - GDPR DPA & SCC selection / controller-processor alignment
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Johnson <alice.johnson@acme.com>
Cc: rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-06-29T14:03:00Z
Subject: Acme Corp - GDPR DPA & SCC selection / controller-processor alignment

Hi Alice,

Thanks again for taking the time today - great conversation with you and the Acme security team. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side: 

- Redwood SOC 2: In progress (Type II audit in Q3 2027). We have the Type I reports and control documentation available now.
- GDPR / DPA: happy to share a Redwood DPA draft and propose SCC modules. Attached a first-pass DPA (Redwood_DPA_draft_v1.pdf) and an SCC selection matrix (SCC_module_selection_matrix.xlsx) for your review.
- Controller / Processor: From the call, it sounds like Acme will remain the controller for customer data and Redwood will act as processor for hosted inference (we also support on-prem/private deployments where roles can differ). Please confirm this mapping on your side.

Next steps I propose:
1) You review the DPA/SCC matrix and mark preferred SCC modules.
2) If the controller/processor mapping looks right, we can prepare a redline-ready contract for your legal team.
3) We can initiate the vendor security questionnaire (happy to coordinate with your security team) and push DocuSign for the DPA once agreed.

Can you confirm timing for steps 1-3? I've looped in Rishi (procurements lead) and Lukas (security engineering) so they can pick up any procurement or technical questions.

Thanks,

- Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0124

Attachment: Redwood_DPA_draft_v1.pdf
Attachment: SCC_module_selection_matrix.xlsx

From: Alice Johnson <alice.johnson@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@acme.com, procurement@acme.com
Date: 2027-06-30T09:10:00Z
Subject: Re: Acme Corp - GDPR DPA & SCC selection / controller-processor alignment

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the recap - I shared the attachments with our legal and security teams. A few clarifications from our side after review: 

- SOC 2: We need the Type I report and control narratives now; Type II is fine to come later but please confirm expected delivery month (you mentioned Q3).
- DPA / SCC: We typically require Modules II and III as a baseline, but I need to confirm Module IV with our data protection officer after they review the matrix.
- Controller/Processor: Acme is definitely the controller. Please confirm that Redwood is willing to be explicitly listed as processor in the DPA and that subprocessors are disclosed in Appendix A (or provide the subprocessors disclosure mechanism).

Procurement asked if you can provide a redline-friendly version (Word or Google Doc) and whether you can start the DocuSign flow once we align on SCC choices. Also - can you kick off the vendor security questionnaire now? They prefer to start that in parallel.

Proposed timeline from us: we'll aim to provide SCC module choices by EOD next Tuesday (2027-07-06).

Best,
Alice
Senior Security Lead, Acme Corp
alice.johnson@acme.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Johnson <alice.johnson@acme.com>
Cc: rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai, lukas.meyer@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-07-01T11:25:00Z
Subject: Re: Acme Corp - GDPR DPA & SCC selection / controller-processor alignment

Alice - thanks, and noted. Quick replies inline: 

- SOC 2: We can provide the Type I report and control narratives immediately - I've linked them below and attached the DPA as a PDF for now. Type II expected completion estimate: 2027-09 (end of Q3).
- Subprocessors: We maintain a subprocessors disclosure page and provide an appendix in the DPA. We'll add a clear Appendix A with current subprocessors and a process for advance notice.
- Docusign / redline: We'll upload a redline-friendly Google Doc and enable commenting. Once you confirm SCC modules we'll initiate DocuSign for the DPA.

I've attached the DPA draft and SCC matrix again. Lukas - can you confirm the subprocessors disclosure process and whether we need any technical controls detail beyond what's in the control narratives?

Rishi - I'll defer procurement coordination to you for the DocuSign and PO/contracts flow.

Links:
- SOC 2 Type I report (internal link): https://drive.google.com/file/d/1SOC2-TYPE1
- Control narratives (summary): https://drive.google.com/file/d/1CTRL-NARR

Thanks,

- Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

Attachment: Redwood_DPA_draft_v1.pdf
Attachment: SCC_module_selection_matrix.xlsx

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: procurement@acme.com, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Alice Johnson <alice.johnson@acme.com>
Cc: lukas.meyer@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-07-02T08:00:00Z
Subject: Re: Acme Corp - GDPR DPA & SCC selection / controller-processor alignment

Hi team - looping in procurement to start commercial paperwork. Quick notes from Redwood procurement side: 

- DocuSign: Once Alice confirms SCC modules, we'll convert the DPA draft to a DocuSign envelope and send to Acme legal. Please confirm signatory and billing contact.
- PO / billing: Acme procurement - please send estimated PO template and billing contact so we can align pricing/commencement terms.
- Vendor security questionnaire: Marissa, we should initiate the questionnaire now. I've attached a short checklist we typically send to prospects; if Acme wants to fill their own form we'll prioritize that.

I can take lead on the contract turnaround and coordinate with finance.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Head of Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai

Attachment: Redwood_Procurement_Checklist.docx

From: Alice Johnson <alice.johnson@acme.com>

Thanks Rishi / Marissa - confirmation from Acme:

- SCC modules: We'll confirm Modules II and III by EOD 2027-07-06.
- Signatory & billing: I’ve looped in procurement (procurement@acme.com) to share the PO template and billing contact. Procurement will also confirm the signatory.
- Vendor security questionnaire: We will start with Redwood's checklist. I’ve attached a filled initial questionnaire (Vendor_Security_Questionnaire_Acme_filled.pdf) and will follow up with any gaps/clarifications.

Once we confirm SCC modules we'll be ready to receive the DocuSign envelope. Appreciate the quick turnaround here.

Cheers,
Alice
Senior Security Lead, Acme Corp
